name: iCode
description: iCode builds an open-source agent development environment. iCode Workbench runs a fleet of CLI coding agents in parallel, each in an isolated Git worktree, with a review-first workflow. iCode Agent is a terminal coding agent that manages its context window on long tasks.

products.name: iCode Workbench
products.description: Run 44 CLI coding agents in parallel, queue durable tasks, review changes where the agent worked, and keep terminals alive across app restarts.

products.name: iCode Agent
products.description: A terminal coding agent that explores, edits, runs tests, and verifies its own work while defending its context budget.

guides.title: Run multiple coding agents in parallel

essays.title: The context window is a budget
What a cross-project agent assistant should do
